decision: Value-aware masking is folded into the existing single T-0021 projection by (a) a NEW pure additive module src/core/data-classification.ts owning the DataClass enum (public|internal|confidential|restricted), the closed Transform vocabulary (reveal|partial|redact|hash|drop), the ClassificationSource injected port (mirrors GrantSource; in-memory now, Postgres RLS DAO in T-0053), the TypedFacet={fields,schemaVersion} additive widening of T-0015 Facet, the (class x clearance)->transform selector selectTransform, the pure applyTransform, the masking fold maskFields, the from->to guard evaluateReclassification, and the ClassificationAuditObligation shape; and (b) surgical ADDITIVE edits to src/core/grant-resolver.ts: ResolverDeps gains optional classifications?: ClassificationSource and projectFields gains an optional 4th MaskContext param, so resolveFor's single projection step calls projectFields(raw, vis, ctx) when a source is present (legacy 2-arg behaviour when absent) -- still ONE projection, ONE core, no second handle->fields export. data_classification migration is number 017 (run-seam: 011/012=T-0116, 013-016=T-0017), per-tenant (tenant_id, resource_type, facet_field, facet_schema_version, class) with PK (tenant_id, resource_type, facet_field, facet_schema_version), CHECK on the closed class set, ENABLE+FORCE RLS, tenant-isolation policy, choros_app DML grant, appended to known_tenant_tables.txt, NO cross-table FK (resource_type is a kind and facet_field is a JSONB key name -- no relational target; mirrors 008_grant.role_id deferred-FK). Mask is value-aware: partial/redact/hash yield a PRESENT transformed value; drop omits the key (the old all-or-nothing maximal mask). Selection is (class x clearance) derived from covering grant rows, never by field name and never via a parallel field-ACL store. Fail-closed: missing rows / version mismatch / unknown class / null clearance all resolve to maximal masking, never widened to whole-resource. Reclassification is a guarded transition/approve op via resolveFor, direction-aware (down==widening==privileged). FROZEN-FILE TENSION resolved: object-handle.ts and grant-lattice.ts stay byte-frozen; the coder MUST drop grant-resolver.ts from mutation-gateway-isolation.sh G6-additive FROZEN_EXPORTS so the legitimate additive masking edit lands, preserving every G1/G2/G6 isolation invariant and the resolveFor/makeGrantResolver/projectFields/visibleFields/grantFacetFields import surface (FE-W23-0008).

rejected_alternatives.option: A second projection function maskProjectFields parallel to projectFields.
rejected_alternatives.why_not: Opens a second handle->fields edge -> single-resolver.sh red; human/agent divergence becomes writable. The fold must be the one function (AC-7, non-negotiable).

rejected_alternatives.option: Edit object-handle.ts so Facet carries schemaVersion + class.
rejected_alternatives.why_not: Breaks the frozen-module invariant (grant-resolver-isolation.sh Check 3) and ripples through parseHandle/serializeHandle wire validation. TypedFacet as an additive widening in the new module is non-breaking.

rejected_alternatives.option: Add a class lattice kind to grant-lattice.ts / a second authority subsystem for clearance.
rejected_alternatives.why_not: NF-2: lattice math stays in T-0018; a second authority subsystem is exactly what grant-resolver-isolation.sh Check 2 forbids. Clearance is derived from existing grant rows, not a new algebra.

Not expressible: resource_type is a kind, facet_field is a JSONB key name, not a row id. An impossible FK fails to apply = BUILD bounce (T-0017 lesson). Logical descriptor, no FK -- like 008_grant.role_id.

rejected_alternatives.option: Bake an egress/allowed_endpoint column into data_classification.
rejected_alternatives.why_not: S-1: egress_policy is T-0041's table; T-0033 only fixes class as the join axis (AC-14). Pre-baking egress couples two tasks and pre-empts T-0041's schema.
AC-6 forbids per-field-name transforms; selection is (class x grant). Field-name rules would be a parallel non-rights-derived store.

rejected_alternatives.option: Store masking decisions / clearance in a field_visibility table.
rejected_alternatives.why_not: FR-8 / AC-8: a parallel field-ACL store is banned; decision is grant-rows + data_classification only.

rejected_alternatives.option: Reversible encryption/tokenization for hash with key custody.
rejected_alternatives.why_not: Out of scope per spec 6-A #12 (gold-plating); hash is a pure non-reversible digest, no key management.

contracts: src/core/data-classification.ts: export type DataClass = 'public'|'internal'|'confidential'|'restricted'; export const DATA_CLASS_ORDER: readonly DataClass[];
export interface ClassificationSource { getClassifications(resourceType: string, facetSchemaVersion: number): ClassificationRow[]; }
export interface TypedFacet { fields: string[]; schemaVersion: number; } export function readFacetVersion(facet: {fields:string[]; schemaVersion?:number} | undefined): number;
export type Clearance = DataClass | null; export function selectTransform(fieldClass: DataClass, clearance: Clearance): Transform;
export function applyTransform(value: unknown, transform: Transform): unknown; // pure, deterministic, no key custody

export function maskFields(rawFields: Record<string,unknown>, visibleFieldSet: ReadonlySet<string>, ctx: MaskContext | undefined): Record<string,unknown>; // undefined ctx => legacy projectFields behaviour

export function classifyDirection(from: DataClass, to: DataClass): 'up'|'down'|'lateral'; export function evaluateReclassification(from: DataClass, to: DataClass, op: Operation, coveringGrants: Grant[]): ReclassDecision;

src/core/grant-resolver.ts (additive): ResolverDeps gains classifications?: ClassificationSource; projectFields(raw, visibleSet, maskCtx?: MaskContext) gains optional 4th param; resolveFor's single projection step delegates to maskFields when deps.classifications present.
